query:
SELECT * FROM customers;
SELECT c.customer_id FROM orders o left join customers c on o.customer_id=c.customer_id;

SELECT * FROM customers;
SELECT * FROM orders;

SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.order_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_id IS NULL
SELECT p.payment_id, p.order_id FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.payment_amount, o.order_amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE p.payment_amount < o.order_amount AND p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.payment_amount, o.order_amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE p.payment_amount > o.order_amount

SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.payment_amount, p.payment_status FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'FAILED'
